title: Plantation Condition & Inspection Priority

classes.label: Stable / Expected Condition
classes.interpretation: Close to baseline with no persistent decline evidence.

classes.label: Watch
classes.interpretation: Mild anomaly, radar-only support, or downgraded small priority patch.

classes.label: Persistent Stress - Inspection Priority
classes.interpretation: Moderate persistent multi-indicator optical anomaly; inspection recommended.

classes.label: High Persistent Anomaly - High Priority
classes.interpretation: Strong persistent spatially coherent optical anomaly; high inspection priority.

warning: Inspection-priority indicator only; not field-validated diagnosis.
